entities.summary: The Maghsoudbeyk Mosque, also known as the Maqsud Beyk Mosque and as the Zolamat Mosque, is a Shi'ite mosque, located on Zolamat Alley near the northeastern corner of Naqsh-e Jahan Square, in Esfahan, in the province of Isfahan, Iran.
